name: Joshi Ryou ni Shinnyuu Shita Danshi ga Tetteiteki ni Oshioki Sareru Hanashi
original_name: 女子寮に侵入した男子が徹底的にお仕置きされる話
source: The main character is a male college student with no female friends and only serious relationships. It is unfortunate, however, that he has been seduced by a friend who can peer into the bath of a longing senior in a new women's dormitory, and he is caught by a junior who teases the senior of the matter by more. The two girls were attempting to rule the body and mind with severe punishment in order to prevent the main character from going against the girl again....
